paragraphs: Agiloft sells contract lifecycle management software that carries an agreement from the initial request through to renewal inside a single governed system. The company aims it at enterprises and at every department a contract touches, naming legal, finance, procurement, sales and IT.

Configuration is meant to be done by point and click, so approval chains and routing logic can be built without writing code. Contract text is turned into structured data, so clauses, obligations and expiration dates become searchable and reportable. AI is embedded in the platform, where the company says agents extract terms, analyze risk and speed up review. Pre-built connectors tie the system to CRM, ERP and sourcing tools so contract data moves in both directions.

Agiloft states that Gartner Magic Quadrant and Forrester Wave reports recognize it as a leader in contract lifecycle management. For a first rollout the company recommends working with its own professional services team or a certified partner. Customer stories on the site describe a legal team gaining a centralized contract repository, improved compliance and real-time KPI visibility.

quote.text: Agiloft has doubled the intake of our contracts, while cutting the amount of time it takes to complete a contract in half.
